name: 数智服务运营台
positioning: 适合区域服务监测、服务工单协同和服务目录运营类网页 Demo

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.font_family: system sans-serif with Chinese platform fonts
design_tokens.shadow_style: soft blue ambient shadows with restrained gradient highlights

layout_rules: Use a deep blue gradient sidebar on wide web layouts and an off-canvas sidebar below 920px.
Show exactly one of five complete top-level pages and never reveal another page by scrolling.
Lead the overview with a strong blue gradient service hero followed by large rounded metric cards.
Use blue-violet gradient accents, soft blue shadows, broad radii, and generous card padding.
Represent regional service health with a ranked horizontal distribution rather than a dense generic table.
Keep work-order filters above the table and inspect one work order in a right-side drawer.
Confirm resolution before updating the work order, region health, overview counts, and notifications.
Treat narrow mode as a responsive web off-canvas layout, never as a native desktop app.

component_inventory.name: service_hero
component_inventory.use_for: prominent service health summary and primary action

component_inventory.name: work_order_table
component_inventory.use_for: filterable and exportable service work orders

component_inventory.name: service_catalog
component_inventory.use_for: service offer composition without fake actions

interaction_contracts: Every enabled control has an observable result; unfinished controls are omitted or disabled with a visible reason.
Navigation synchronizes the active page, aria-current, breadcrumb, document title, URL hash, scroll position, and narrow sidebar state.
Period controls recalculate response metrics and the trend chart from shared mock state.
Work-order filtering updates the current result count and a truthful empty state; reset restores all rows.
CSV export downloads a nonempty file containing the current filtered work orders.
Resolving a work order requires confirmation and updates table, drawer, overview metrics, region health, and notifications.
Creating a work order validates required fields before updating overview, region, table, and notification state.
Drawer and dialogs close with explicit controls and Escape, trap focus, and restore focus to the opener.
Settings save and restore mutate the current demo state and period controls.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep all core flows keyboard operable.

preserve: deep blue web sidebar and light blue-gray canvas
blue-violet gradient hero and primary actions
large rounded cards with soft blue ambient shadows
wave-based trend treatment and rounded region health bars
airier service-oriented copy and component rhythm
replace_from_development_document: product name, navigation labels, and page hierarchy
service metrics, period definitions, and chart values
regions, work-order fields, statuses, owners, and allowed transitions
filters, table columns, service catalog, notifications, and settings
mock records and all user-facing business copy
avoid: Hope UI logos, brand names, screenshots, illustrations, icons, fonts, product copy, or upstream source code
commercial-only or PRO components and assets
external libraries, CDNs, remote images, analytics, APIs, or build tools
native desktop window chrome or operating-system app conventions
fake enabled actions or success feedback without state change
using color alone to communicate health or status

single_file_compilation.style_source: inline the complete contents of tokens.css into a style element
single_file_compilation.script_source: inline the complete contents of interactions.js before the closing body tag
single_file_compilation.asset_policy: use inline SVG and CSS shapes only; do not introduce external URLs
